features: Adds one persistent Live Display URL per event for a separate projector PC
Projector PC can open the display link once and receive remote feed changes without changing URLs
Adds authenticated remote controller for Holding, Judges, Competitors, Scoring, Callbacks, Finalists, Final Ranking and Winners
Remote display polls for controller state changes and swaps the displayed feed automatically
Round selection is database-driven, so events only show rounds that actually exist and never invent a Heats or Semifinal stage
Adds automatic multi-page rotation for Competitors, Callbacks and Finalists
Auto paging defaults to 30 seconds and supports 10, 15, 30, 45 or 60 second delays
Adds page number and Auto Page On/Off controls
Live Display link is read-only and cannot change scoring or competition data
Live Display architecture supports both Real and isolated Test event sessions
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
